title: More room for the model, stage 4: think first, choose the kind of work last, behind a switch
request: The owner asked for stage four before stage three: the lead agent writes the problem, what needs care, the approach and the plan before it chooses a kind of work, then does the first step in the same turn.
spec: A switch, off by default, with nothing changed while it is off. A new prompt file, a first-turn note, room for the message, and a rewrite at the same length. A held-out set of people, a second gate pinned before any change, and the model alone held to the lead agent's length.
plan: lock a held-out set written outside this work and pin a second gate
write the new prompt as its own file and the switch in code
add the model alone held to the same length

decisions.decision: A new prompt file, not an edit of the old one
decisions.why: with the switch off the lead agent must stay exactly as it was

decisions.decision: The held-out set is written outside this work and read only as means
decisions.why: fixes made while watching the earlier sets did not carry to new people

decisions.decision: The second gate compares both judged checks with the same model alone
decisions.why: no floor taken from a set the repair was tuned on

decisions.decision: A figures request keeps its table-first rule with the switch on
decisions.why: the owner's rule that a figure is answered first stands

change: The lead agent's switch, prompt choice, first-turn note, reply limit and rewrite; a new prompt; the model alone held to the same length; a second gate; the benchmark keeps runs of the switch on apart and a held-out run to its means; the test runner blanks the switch.

findings.defect: With the switch on, a figures request lost its table-first note.
findings.scenario: A request for a chart of their table was told to write the long message first.
findings.fix: A figures request keeps the old note, and the prompt says it comes first.

findings.defect: The tool results asked for the message a second time.
findings.scenario: The plan was written twice and the limit cut the copy.
findings.fix: With the switch on the result says a message already written stands.

findings.defect: The rule to offer the sound way met gates that refuse a single option.
findings.scenario: One option was refused for want of a second, and the start as not ready.
findings.fix: The prompt asks for two sound ways of different kinds, or the sound version inside a Home pick.

findings.defect: Runs with the switch on and off could be read as one run.
findings.scenario: The same label, model and judge joined them and kept only the later conversations.
findings.fix: The switch is part of a run's key and its name.

findings.defect: A second-gate verdict was drawn under the first gate's headings.
findings.scenario: A check of the second gate had no column and the title named the first.
findings.fix: Each gate has its own table.

findings.defect: The benchmark file kept a held-out run person by person.
findings.scenario: The page hid it; the file beside it did not.
findings.fix: A held-out run is stored as means only.

outcome: The switch, the prompt and the measurement are in place and tested; with the switch off nothing changed. Whether thinking first closes the gap is measured next, last of all on the held-out people.
lessons: A switch that changes a prompt must also change the tool results that answer it.
A held-out set is only held out if every place that stores results keeps it to its means.
risks: Longer replies and more time per turn.
A confident plan can still be wrong; code checks its steps, not its idea.
